subject: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Notice of Intent
overview: The Medford Conservation Commission convened without a quorum and voted to continue its single agenda item to August 16, 2023.

items.title: 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway Notice of Intent
items.summary: Continued the Notice of Intent hearing for proposed redevelopment at 4000 Mystic Valley Parkway (DEP File 215-0233) to August 16, 2023, due to the lack of a quorum.
